endorsements.name: Gregory Fleischer
endorsements.label: Web Tracking for You
endorsements.description: There has been a lot of conversation recently around the privacy degrading techniques used by shady online advertisers, faceless megacorps, and social network overlords to track users across the web. But, after all the recriminations and fancy infographics about the supposed loss of privacy, where does that leave people who need to implement tracking of website visitors? People seem so distracted with "punch the monkey" advertising cookies that they have lost a sense of the need to legitimately track and identify potential bad actors.
